cases.name: setup: create test story
cases.execute: const r = await $handlers.story_quick({name:'cl-add-test',title:'checklist_add test story',description:'test',type:'feature',priority:'low',checklist:[{title:'placeholder',context:'ctx'}]}); $ctx.storyId = r.match(/B-[a-f0-9]+/)[0]; return r

cases.name: happy:0 — add item with title+context, ID = CHK-002
cases.execute: return await $handlers.checklist_add({storyId:$ctx.storyId,title:'新功能',context:'上下文说明'})

cases.name: happy:0 — verify item persisted in checklist
cases.execute: const cl = await $handlers.checklist_get({storyId:$ctx.storyId}); const item = cl.items.find(i=>i.id==='CHK-002'); return item ? item.id+'|'+item.title+'|'+item.context+'|'+item.status : 'NOT_FOUND'

cases.name: happy:1 — add third item, auto-assign CHK-003, original items unchanged
cases.execute: await $handlers.checklist_add({storyId:$ctx.storyId,title:'第三项',context:'ctx3'}); const cl = await $handlers.checklist_get({storyId:$ctx.storyId}); const ids = cl.items.map(i=>i.id).join(','); return 'ids='+ids

cases.name: setup: create empty-checklist story
cases.execute: const r = await $handlers.story_quick({name:'cl-add-empty',title:'empty checklist test',description:'test',type:'feature',priority:'low',checklist:[{title:'temp',context:'x'}]}); $ctx.emptyStoryId = r.match(/B-[a-f0-9]+/)[0]; return r

cases.name: edge:0 — empty checklist assigns CHK-001
cases.execute: const {writeFileSync} = await import('fs'); const {join} = await import('path'); const p = join($root,'docs/story/actives',String($ctx.emptyStoryId),'checklist.json'); writeFileSync(p,JSON.stringify({items:[]})); return await $handlers.checklist_add({storyId:$ctx.emptyStoryId,title:'first item'})

cases.name: edge:1 — add item in DEV phase succeeds
cases.execute: const fs = await import('fs'); const {join} = await import('path'); const idxPath = join($root,'docs/story/actives',String($ctx.storyId),'index.json'); const idx = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(idxPath,'utf-8')); idx.phase = 'DEV'; fs.writeFileSync(idxPath, JSON.stringify(idx, null, 2)); return await $handlers.checklist_add({storyId:$ctx.storyId,title:'DEV phase item',context:'added during dev'})

cases.name: edge:2 — long title (500 chars) preserved
cases.execute: const longTitle = 'A'.repeat(500); await $handlers.checklist_add({storyId:$ctx.storyId,title:longTitle,context:'long'}); const cl = await $handlers.checklist_get({storyId:$ctx.storyId}); const last = cl.items[cl.items.length-1]; return 'len='+last.title.length+' match='+(last.title === longTitle)

cases.name: edge:3 — context omitted, item created successfully
cases.execute: await $handlers.checklist_add({storyId:$ctx.storyId,title:'no context item'}); const cl = await $handlers.checklist_get({storyId:$ctx.storyId}); const last = cl.items[cl.items.length-1]; return 'title='+last.title+' context='+String(last.context)

cases.name: adversarial:3 — JSON special chars in title/context preserved
cases.execute: const special = 'quotes"here\\back'; await $handlers.checklist_add({storyId:$ctx.storyId,title:special,context:special}); const cl = await $handlers.checklist_get({storyId:$ctx.storyId}); const last = cl.items[cl.items.length-1]; return 'match='+(last.title === special && last.context === special)

cases.name: adversarial:1 — concurrent adds get different IDs
cases.execute: const [r1,r2] = await Promise.all([$handlers.checklist_add({storyId:$ctx.storyId,title:'concurrent-A'}),$handlers.checklist_add({storyId:$ctx.storyId,title:'concurrent-B'})]); const cl = await $handlers.checklist_get({storyId:$ctx.storyId}); const ids = cl.items.map(i=>i.id); const uniqueIds = new Set(ids); return 'allUnique='+(ids.length === uniqueIds.size)+' count='+ids.length

cases.name: adversarial:2 — deleted checklist file mid-execution throws error
cases.execute: const fs = await import('fs'); const {join} = await import('path'); const dir = join($root,'docs/story/actives',String($ctx.emptyStoryId)); const p = join(dir,'checklist.json'); try { fs.unlinkSync(p); } catch {}; let err = ''; try { await $handlers.checklist_add({storyId:$ctx.emptyStoryId,title:'after delete'}); } catch(e) { err = e.message || String(e); } const fileExists = fs.existsSync(p); const dirFiles = fs.readdirSync(dir); const hasCorrupt = dirFiles.some(f => f.includes('checklist') && f !== 'checklist.json'); return 'threw='+(err.length>0)+' fileExists='+fileExists+' noCorrupt='+(!hasCorrupt)
